name: Timemore Chestnut S3
details: Hand grinder with external stepless-feel adjustment.

notes.turkish: Not fine enough for Turkish coffee.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–0.5, moka pot 0.4–3.8, AeroPress 0–7.2, V60 0.9–4.2, filter coffee machine 0–6.5, French press 4.2–9, cold brew 5.5–9. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Timemore's own manual is reported to give different numbers for the 2025 model (pour-over 5–8, French press 8–9) — check which you have.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
